summary: EarthBound/Mother entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: EarthBound
entries.definitive_edition: SNES version through Nintendo Switch Online/Nintendo Classics for current official access

emulation.emulator: bsnes / SNES9x only if official route is unavailable
emulation.notes: Use official Nintendo Classics route where possible; document emulator/core if used.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Super NES hardware or accurate SNES emulation

primary.version: SNES version through Nintendo Switch Online
primary.why: EarthBound is now officially available through Nintendo's SNES Classics service, making it the practical current route for the original SNES game. Original Super NES hardware remains the top historical-fidelity route, while the Japan-only Mother 1+2 GBA port should be treated as a separate variant.
primary.how_to_play: Use the SNES version through Nintendo Switch Online/Nintendo Classics. Record service version, region, controller, save-state/rewind use, guide/hint use, and whether original SNES or Mother 1+2 was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving exact 1990s hardware and packaging context.
secondary.why: The Switch route is current and official, but the original release is the historical artifact.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the GBA variant.
secondary.why: It is not the same route as the SNES release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record save-state/rewind and guide use; keep Mother 1+2 and Mother 3 separate from this entry.

entries.title: Mother
entries.definitive_edition: EarthBound Beginnings on Nintendo Switch Online / Nintendo Classics

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official English route with wrapper state documented

primary.version: EarthBound Beginnings via Nintendo Switch Online / Nintendo Classics
primary.why: Mother is now officially available in English as EarthBound Beginnings through Nintendo's classic-game service. That route is the practical current legal route, while the Famicom original and Mother 1+2 GBA compilation remain important version-history comparisons.
primary.how_to_play: Use EarthBound Beginnings on Nintendo Switch Online/Nintendo Classics. Record service/app version, suspend/rewind state, region/language, party level, map/story progress, save state, and whether Famicom or GBA versions were compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original Japanese release and GBA compilation route
secondary.why: Switch Online is the current official English route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record suspend/rewind/language and do not merge with EarthBound/Mother 2.

entries.title: Mother 3
entries.definitive_edition: Japanese GBA original; fan translation for English-language capture if using an owned dump

emulation.emulator: mGBA or accurate GBA emulator if hardware unavailable
emulation.notes: Rhythm combat is timing/audio sensitive; document emulator and latency settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original GBA hardware for authenticity; accurate GBA emulation for capture

primary.platform: Game Boy Advance / owned Japanese copy with translation route documented
primary.version: Japanese GBA release; fan-translation patch only if English is required
primary.why: Mother 3 is officially a Japan-only Game Boy Advance release, with later Japan-only official digital routes. For an English-language archive playthrough, the practical route is an owned Japanese copy/dump with the fan translation patch clearly labeled; for pure official fidelity, use the Japanese GBA or Japanese Nintendo Classics route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Japanese GBA cartridge/hardware or accurate GBA emulation. If playing in English, apply the fan-translation patch to a legally owned dump and record patch version, emulator/core, language route, rhythm-combat latency/audio settings, chapter, save state, and whether Japanese NSO/Wii U VC was compared.

secondary.platform: Japanese Nintendo Classics / Wii U Virtual Console
secondary.what_to_play: Use for official wrapper comparison if accessible.
secondary.why: It is official, but remains Japanese-language and service/account dependent.

secondary.exclusive_content: Development-history context, not playable final content
secondary.why: The final released game is the GBA version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official English release is sourced. Record language and patch route explicitly.
